checks.description: Indicator is decorative and unstyled, with no theme, product tokens, interaction or checkbox state ownership.
Checked renders check, indeterminate renders dash, unchecked renders neither; root remains inaccessible.

tests.name: CheckboxIndicator renders checked and indeterminate glyphs as decorative content

checks.description: Checked and indeterminate source overrides are independent and only active source receives iconColor and iconSize.
Ordinary native View ref prop receives the root.

tests.name: CheckboxIndicator forwards its ref prop to the native root

checks.description: Unowned native/accessibility/test props forward without allowing consumer overrides to make owned decorative root semantic.
Compiled SlotProp accepts status/color/size and rejects caller children.
Native owner announces checkbox status once while indicator glyphs remain decorative in every state.

limitations: Source overrides and color/size forwarding lack linked assertion coverage; state smoke does not prove those clauses.
Type fixture is included by the owning tsconfig, but this mapping is not a compiler or native execution result.
No native decorative-tree observation is linked.
